parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ keyword: $fromAI("keyword", "Job title or keyword to search on Naukri, e.g. QA Officer", "string"), location: $fromAI("location", "Search location/state, e.g. Gujarat", "string", "Gujarat"), max_results: $fromAI("max_results", "Maximum listings to scrape in pass 1, default 150", "number", 150) }) }}
parameters.toolDescription: Server-side two-pass scraper and filter for Naukri jobs. Runs cheap list scrape, filters consultants and stale postings (>29 days), dedups against existing Jobdrive leads in Postgres, enriches surviving job IDs with apply counts and contact details, and applies volume floor and velocity filters. Inputs: keyword (required string), location (optional string, default 'Gujarat'), max_results (optional number, default 150). Returns compact JSON array of qualified company objects matching the radar contract plus one meta object.
